assertions.name: TestCIScriptsCannotSilentlyPass
assertions.semantics: Optional owned ci.sh, linewise # comment stripping, exact ) && echo or } && echo false-green shape

assertions.name: TestEveryDeployedImageIsTrivyScanned
assertions.semantics: Native push-deploy discovery does not include manual Relay. Portable additional assertion requires reviewed manual DeploySpec, root Dockerfile and Relay membership from security_trivy.go; actual scan belongs to separate required final-image job. Unrelated estate registrations/nonempty discovery are not claimed

assertions.name: TestEveryGoModuleIsGatedOrExempt
assertions.semantics: Top-level owned go.mod must be in ciGoServices or carry nonempty ciGoExempt reason; nested VoIP independently executed

assertions.name: TestEveryPublishableProductHasCI
assertions.semantics: Owned nonexempt split-public-repo.sh presence requires both scripts/ci.sh and .github/workflows/ci.yml; absent app publisher explicitly reported

assertions.name: TestCIGoExemptOnlyNamesRealModules
assertions.semantics: Each exemption within owned root must have go.mod; no Relay exemption explicitly reported

assertions.name: TestServiceDockerfilesMatchScanToolchain
assertions.semantics: Exact Relay module/go/toolchain; reviewed1.26.7/1.26.9/1.26.10 compiler; bounded all-Dockerfile inventory; literal FROM grammar, base families, aliases, digests, continued RUN and heredoc refusal; every Go builder equals selected compiler

assertions.name: TestCIScriptsRunRaceWhereCIGoDoes
assertions.semantics: Optional local script; exact adjacent go or go_release test with exact ./... and -race; exact e2e exclusion; scoped real/stale/unreachable race-debt semantics

assertions.name: TestSecurityGateProductionRootsHaveNoHardcodedProviderCredentialShapes
assertions.semantics: Owned production root only; exact private provider regexp, includes and fixture exclusions; same legacy scan limits; locations only

assertions.name: TestSecurityGateRepositoryHasNoHardcodedServiceCredentials
assertions.semantics: Exact private contextual regex/capture/minimum data; candidate-only placeholder classification; same owned roots, includes/exclusions/walker limits; locations only

assertions.name: TestOperationalScriptsRequireExternalCredentials
assertions.semantics: Only the explicit brightcrm credential case: exact sibling ops/scripts/nocodb-to-espocrm-import.py must contain required os.environ ESPOCRM_API_KEY access
